params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in the result set. Values above 100 return 400 rest_invalid_param.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: type
params.description: Limit results to items of an object type.

params.name: subtype
params.description: Limit results to items of one or more object subtypes.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes specific IDs.

params.name: include
params.description: Limit result set to specific IDs.

items.docs: Cross-content search returning lightweight hits (`id`, `title`, `url`, `type`, `subtype`). Seven objects are searchable on this deployment — the 6 pages plus the placeholder post.
